input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It exposes interfaces for managing customized response blur, response entity blur. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with customized response blur functionality, so that I can accomplish my customized response blur-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with response entity blur functionality, so that I can accomplish my response entity blur-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
